title: Future Plans, Opinions & Personality
subtitle: Use future forms, describe people, and share clear opinions.

sections.label: Lesson Notes
sections.title: What we explored
sections.intro: We practised future plans, decisions, personality words, and the difference between an opinion and an active thought.

cards.title: Future choices
cards.text: Use going to for plans and will for a decision made at the moment.

cards.title: Meaning matters
cards.text: Think can express an opinion or an active process.

cards.title: Describe people carefully
cards.text: Use personality words with evidence and context.

readings.title: A plan for Sunday
readings.text: Emre is going to meet friends on Sunday. A birthday party is coming up, so he will buy a small gift. He thinks this is a good plan.
